company.name: ChatHealthy.AI
company.entity_type: Sole proprietorship (IP licensing pending - LEG Q4)

product.description: AI-native consumer healthcare navigation chatbot. Users describe needs in natural language, system finds providers, identifies specialties, discovers clinical trials, and handles lead capture with HIPAA-compliant consent.
features: External Provider Lookup (Healthgrades, Zocdoc, NPI Registry)
URL Guardian (validate + defang broken links, AI content verification)
Chat UX (think timer, stop button, markdown, emergency lock)
Validated Provider Web Research (NPI API lookup + link validation)
Markdown Table Rendering (GFM tables in chat)

utility.role: Query expansion, summarization, de-identification, URL verification

technology.database: MongoDB Atlas (FrontEnd cluster: always-on, DataPipelines cluster: on-demand)
technology.blob_storage: Azure Blob Storage (admin, dev-brain, provider-data, chathealthy-public-data)
technology.vendor_diversity: Safety classifier on OpenAI (GPT-4.1-mini), main chat on Anthropic (Sonnet). If one vendor goes down, safety still works.

primary_streams.description: Direct-to-consumer monthly subscription for premium healthcare navigation

License ChatHealthy navigation engine to healthcare technology vendors who serve health plans, providers, PBMs. The SaaS vendor pays ChatHealthy. ChatHealthy has no direct financial relationship with care-chain entities.
primary_streams.compliance: GOV-001 compliant - revenue from technology partner, not care-chain entity

primary_streams.description: Free tier for user acquisition, premium features for subscribers
primary_streams.purpose: Lower barrier to entry, build user base, convert to paid

prohibited_revenue_sources: Any entity in the care delivery or payment chain

exit_strategy.description: Acquisition by healthcare SaaS vendor, competitor, insurance company, or technology company. GOV-001 constrains operating revenue, not exit. Acquirer buys the technology, user base, and proprietary data.

moat.description: ChatHealthy's governance policies (neutrality, single-tenant, transparency) are business decisions that competitors won't make because they conflict with revenue optimization. Neutrality means no referral fees. These constraints build user trust that monetization-first platforms cannot replicate.
components: Provider neutrality (GOV-001) - no care-chain revenue = unbiased recommendations
Proprietary provider quality scoring from user interactions (over time)
De-identified aggregate health navigation data (unique dataset)
Brain Loop AI collaboration framework (development methodology advantage)
First-mover in AI-native healthcare navigation (vs AI bolted onto existing platforms)

competitors.name: Google Health
competitors.differentiator: General search, not specialized. No HIPAA consent flow.

risks.mitigation: SaaS vendor partnerships for indirect B2B revenue + exit/acquisition as fallback

risks.risk: LLM vendor concentration (97% on Anthropic Sonnet)
risks.mitigation: Safety on OpenAI (vendor diversity). Portability refactoring (Sprint 2) enables model swapping. LLM costs dropping ~50% YoY.
Two-tier consent flow implemented. 4 pending legal questions tracked. Legal review before beta.
AI-assisted development (Claude + ChatGPT). Brain Loop autonomous collaboration. Hire after funding.

risks.risk: Weak moat - competitors replicate AI features
risks.mitigation: Governance-as-moat (trust). Proprietary data over time. First-mover advantage.
Temporary policy (GOV-003). Revisit when funding secured. Copyright retained.

investor_pitch.narrative: ChatHealthy is the only AI-native healthcare navigation platform that refuses revenue from the care chain. Our governance policies - neutrality, single-tenant, transparency - are our competitive moat. Users trust us because we have no incentive to bias recommendations. Dual-path growth: consumer subscriptions for direct revenue, SaaS vendor licensing for scale, acquisition for exit.
key_metrics_needed: Resolved HIPAA compliance questions (remove investor blockers)
At least one healthcare SaaS vendor partnership (prove B2B model)
User retention and engagement data (prove value)
investor_pitch.ask: Seed funding to scale from alpha (2 states) to beta (10+ states), hire engineering + compliance team, execute SaaS vendor partnerships.

beta_v05.milestone: 10+ states, automated tests, ErrorBoundary, portability refactoring, maps

production_v10.milestone: National coverage, SaaS vendor partnership, investor-ready

series_a.milestone: 100K users, proven B2B model, regulatory compliance complete
